# Rushing yards + qb rushing yards tuning (rushlead): tune seasons only

*Generated by `backtest.py --tune-width --tune-grid rushlead --tune 2022,2023`. Do not edit by hand. This run read the tune seasons only.*

Round 15: the eligible carry shares rescaled toward 1 - rush_other_share with the correction ADDED and split away from the lead back (rush_norm_lead = his weight in the split; 1.0 = #103's proportional rescale). *Off* = no rescaling (what ships). Diagnosis behind it (2022-23 only, DECISIONS #133): the #2 backs carry the miss in both directions. Every other setting is held at the shipped values (`{"catch_conc": null, "eff_sd_qb": 0.15, "eff_sd_rec": 0.0, "eff_sd_rush": 0.3, "share_conc_carries": 20.0, "share_conc_qb": 80.0, "share_conc_targets": 40.0}`). Rule: CRPS summed over rushing yards + QB rushing yards (each relative to the family off) first; among settings not measurably worse than the best, the actual/model mean closest to 1.00.
